Opus claimed officer on Day 1, Sonnet said Opus was the killer, and the town voted Sonnet out 4 to 3. Night 2 took Luna, and on Day 2 Sol and Terra backed the officer's read, so Opus was voted out after admitting he was faking a claim. His big mistake was claiming officer against the real officer, but his last words naming Terra as his partner were his best move. On Day 3 the town voted Terra out, and Terra's card showed doctor. Night 3 took Sol, leaving Gemma and Haiku, one killer and one other, so the killers won.
